description:
Hosts with pending security updates, with the package names and versions for each.

Shorter than list_pending_updates and usually the relevant one. Naming each package
costs one API request, so max_packages_per_host caps how many are resolved per host;
the update count itself is always exact.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50, maximum 500.

name: list_pending_security_updates

outputSchema.description: Rows plus enough context to know whether they are all of them.

hint.description: How to narrow the query when truncated.

items.description: The rows, at most `limit` of them.

truncated.description: True if openITCOCKPIT held more rows than were returned.

title: Pending Security Updates
